facts.fact: Achi Shrine stands on Tsurugata hill and has a continuing protective-shrine relationship with central Kurashiki and Bikan.
facts.excerpt: 美観地区はじめ倉敷中心地の鎮守の杜である。

facts.fact: The principal deities are the three Munakata goddesses, associated with maritime and transport safety.
facts.excerpt: 航海の安全を司る宗像三女神を祀る

facts.fact: The shrine moved to its current site in1594; the main shrine roof is hinoki bark, with reroofing completed inMarch2024.
facts.excerpt: 令和６年３月、およそ30年ぶりとなる檜皮の葺き替えが完了

facts.fact: Its wisteria has a seasonal flowering context, not a yearround floral promise; omit exact flowering guarantees and uncertain tree age.
facts.excerpt: 樹齢については300から500年と定かではありません。
